description: Add a context-sensitive terrain scanner readout that identifies the tile directly in the ship's movement/drill direction before players commit fuel or hull to it.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh before development and retain the existing React-before-runtime startup order and DOM IDs/classes consumed by src/dom.ts and src/game.ts.

Inspect src/game.ts movement/drilling decisions, src/world.ts tile shapes, src/constants.ts and src/balance.ts thresholds, src/ui.tsx HUD hooks, src/dom.ts, src/styles.css, and relevant Vitest coverage to define a small DOM-free scanner formatter/classifier for air, dirt, ore, solid rock, magma, dormant fiends, and the Motherlode.

Add one stable, always-visible HUD scanner hook near the objective/service guidance and update it from the current intended movement/drill direction (or a safe default adjacent direction), showing a concise actionable distinction such as clear route, drillable target and hits/value when available, solid-rock detour, magma hull/fuel risk, or fiend warning without exposing stale values after reset, game over, or load.

Keep scanner copy derived from the real tile/balance data instead of duplicating thresholds, preserve keyboard and touch movement behavior, and style the readout to stay readable without crowding the phone HUD or leaking through the Info / Cargo modal.

Add unit tests for the DOM-free scanner decisions/formatting plus React/runtime-hook coverage; run ./init.sh and a live desktop and phone-size CDP smoke that starts the game, drills toward starter terrain, observes scanner changes for a mined/clear target and a dangerous or blocked target, opens/closes Info / Cargo, moves again, and collects runtime exceptions.
acceptance: Before drilling, players can see an always-visible concise scanner readout for the current adjacent target that clearly differentiates a clear route, ordinary drillable terrain/ore, solid rock, magma, and tunnel-fiend danger using real game state.

The scanner updates as the player changes direction or mines, remains correct after load/reset/game-over paths, does not replace or regress the existing objective, cargo-value, service guidance, Info / Cargo navigation, keyboard/touch controls, or responsive HUD layout, and remains usable at a phone viewport.
DOM-free scanner logic and React/runtime hook coverage pass, and live desktop/phone browser smokes report no runtime exceptions while confirming the scanner reacts to gameplay.
Before marking complete, follow miner-daily-task-runner and run ./init.sh, ./test.sh, npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build as fresh final verification.
